split_policy.rule: T-B02 held-out set. Every repository here is unseen by retrieval-policy tuning: none appears in retrieval-policy-v1 or heldout-language-rotation-2026-08-02. The 2026-08-02 rotation panel is deliberately excluded because its cross-repo recall moved (0.841 -> 0.886) during the OW-AC-03 tuning window, so it can no longer support a head-to-head claim. The train slot is a third-party frozen checkout rather than this repository, so the suite does not self-invalidate each time its own HEAD moves. No repository here may be used to tune retrieval; a fix motivated by these tasks retires the suite.

known_limitations: The protocol's lexical_disjoint guard compares a query only against its own expected_nodes' tokens. It does not compare the query against the rest of the graph's vocabulary, so a task can pass the guard while lexically matching a SIBLING of the target and reaching it in one expansion hop. Two ratatui tasks were authored that way and were rewritten once measured; both original phrasings are recorded in their oracle_refs. When adding tasks here, additionally confirm with a lexical search that neither the target nor its immediate neighbours appear in the top lexical hits.

Doc-node share does not explain per-project conceptual recall: requests carries the highest doc share (58.2%) and scores 0.000, while ratatui at 46.9% and crush at 19.9% score 0.667-before-correction and 0.000. An early reading of raw paragraph counts suggested otherwise and was wrong.

Measured numbers are configuration-dependent and must state their source mode. The semantic index is NOT built by `graphgraph scan`; it is built by `graphgraph platform semantic --rebuild`. Under --source-mode auto three independent gates can each keep it out of a query: a missing or stale index, a cold embedding backend (every cold CLI process; auto refuses to pay FastEmbed's first-load cost), and _weak_lexical judging lexical strong enough that the index is never consulted. The first published figures here (0.154 / 0.111 / 0.000) were taken with NO index on disk and therefore measured lexical retrieval alone. With current real-embedding indexes present: auto still scores 0.000 (gates block it), --source-mode all scores 0.111. Always record the mode alongside the number.
